decision.reason: Structure the headstock (sill beam) plan setout already in the description's abutment takeoff (custom.takeoff_abutments rows 21-27, Direct / Calculated) into the new catalogue table supports[].headstock_setout, so the substructure model builder can place the sill beam. Sign convention read from the takeoff: front face positive = toward the span; start = south end (negative), end = north end (positive) along the printed bearing-line direction 044 deg 01'45" (toward the northern side, takeoff row 17). The sill end positions are the FRONT-FACE ends; the model uses them for the centroid line (sill end faces assumed square to the line of bearings, not confirmed). No new values: structuring only.
